summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the PeriodPills two-variant fix (short list → stretched, long list → scrollable) after iteration_29's regression. ALL 8 targeted flows PASS. Short-list variants render as original stretched thirds (Transactions filter ~108.3px, Net Worth ~108.3px, Settings appearance/experience ~96.3px). Long-list variants scroll horizontally with content-hugging widths (Legacy 8 pills @64px each with 'Retirement' fully readable; Budget 13 pills @64px scrollable to Year; Add-transaction month picker 12 pills @64px scrollable). Iteration_29 regression fixes (Coaching single CTA and Membership $90) also confirmed intact. All regression checks pass (home bell, support GET HELP hub, Reports screen, powered-by-jaleter footer on More/Support). No new UI issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx still 3765 lines — well past 700-line guideline. Splitting per-screen would make future PeriodPills-style global-component regressions easier to catch.

PeriodPills variant threshold (`values.length > 5`) is a magic number; consider a named constant (e.g. `PILL_SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 5`) with a comment listing every consumer and its length so future edits know the impact radius.
